name: s81bf_front_static_clk-c10-COMMIT
purpose: c10 (S-ELEM-PQ/BF 2026-10-16; c9 gate/route measured ck 13,185 sinks TT insertion 363 ps / spread 116 ps, CTS skew dominated by the two root ICG cones: u_fcg ENA low-phase latch 267 ps vs cloned ICG CLK 161 ps (routed reg->reg -35.7 ps at u_fcg ENA), u_ze -> u_cg ENA 140 ps; pins: W/E 776-bit buses packed into the middle 37% of the face at 10.4 pins/um, N 1,024-bit bus 10.4 pins/um on M5 only, clock entry at the SW corner, fill 0.632). STRUCTURE: (1) the static-programme core has NO clock gate: fclk = gclk = ck, one ungated balanced tree (u_fcg, its latch and the u_cg ICG removed); every former gclk register loads under its own kept copy of the registered gate enable (35 ot_v41_kreg u_cen, d = ze_d, async set on rst_n_pin like u_ze): exact by construction (an ICG passes edge t iff its low-phase latch holds ze_q(t-1), the value a data enable samples at t), 0 cycles; (2) outline 100.224 -> 116.64 x 198.72 (fill <= 0.60 incl. the enable muxes); (3) pins re-spaced by face with bit order kept: W/E over the whole face on M4 (4.0 pins/um), N/S alternating M5/M3 (N 4.6 pins/um per layer), ck + io_clk at the face centre. Pin registers: RTL registers every port at the pin already (recipe-3 synthesis pin_regs opted out with reason). Variant S: ck/io_clk at the S-face centre. Evidence (results/rtl/s81_bf_clock_1015/c10): full BF bench positive 456 rows/912 values/448 config TXN MATCH, lag 6.664/15.827/9.923 ns unchanged, FRD_CHECK positive PASS, prog_bypass + seam_lk mutants FAIL; static front gate PASS + 9 mutants FAIL; CTS gate (2cfe5f0c2): ck 13,221 sinks TT insertion 207.9..238.5 ps spread 30.6 (c9 363.3/116.0), setup WNS 0.0 / hold +15.4 ps. Accepted WARN: two kept enable copies drive 3,224 mux loads each (the 1,600-bit boundary capture blocks) -- a full-cycle registered net buffered by the resizer, not a timing path at risk.
